title: US Navy 050422-M-8797S-022 U.S. Navy Seabees level out the primary landing zone aboard Camp Blue Diamond so they are able to lay down metal plating
description:
Al Anbar Province, Iraq (April 22, 2005) – U.S. Navy Seabees level out the primary landing zone aboard Camp Blue Diamond so they are able to lay down metal plating to help prevent helicopters from kicking up dust when taking off or landing. Marines assigned to 2nd Marine Division conduct Security and Stabilization Operations (SASO) in the Al Anabar Province in support of Operation Iraqi Freedom 
(OIF). U.S. Marine Corps photo by Cpl. Thomas Schaeffer (RELEASED)
author: U.S. Marine Corps photo by Cpl. Thomas Schaeffer
